extractorUtilities.upstream.ts.

Prisma adaptation, 2026-10-09: removed TypeScript and object wrappers;
specialized mu(1) for the centroid; added guards for empty/silent spectra
and bounded numerical rounding. The input uses Orb's existing native
Web Audio FFT (Blackman window), not Meyda's default Hanning FFT pipeline.
Values are therefore not asserted identical to a full Meyda analysis.
Prisma wrapper limits the band to 30–16000 Hz, converts centroid bins to Hz
and maps 80–8000 Hz logarithmically into a 0–1 brightness control.
Flatness describes noise-like versus tonal spectra, not sound recognition
or pitch tracking. No additional AudioContext, FFT, callback or network call.
